name: arya-ai
description: Indian-law plugin for advocates: research, drafting for the Bombay High Court and Maharashtra tribunals, NCLT/NCLAT/IBC pleadings, business contracts, AI-practice safeguards, protocol search, and local DOCX export.

interface.shortDescription: Indian-law research and drafting, Maharashtra courts and NCLT.
interface.longDescription: arya-ai combines Indian-law specialist agents, command prompts, protocol references, legal drafting templates, and a local MCP server for Indian lawyers. It covers contract, criminal, civil procedure, corporate, NCLT/NCLAT, IBC, labour, property, IP, consumer, RTI, PIL, writs, ADR, and document workflows.
defaultPrompt: Draft an Indian legal notice from these facts.
Check limitation and forum for this dispute.
